scope: Selected G4 mapping and independently validated source-applicability domain

scope: Every required computational privacy experiment of the selected G4 mapping
text: Computational privacy admission MUST enforce a canonical rational maximum strictly below one, independently established nonempty scope and genuine protected alternatives, uniform whole-class and whole-view coverage, and the exact non-vacuity qualification and failure contract below; numerical targets MUST remain independently source-governed and no vacuous claim MAY discharge a required privacy duty.
